sources.quality_notes: Madras Foster Press 1885, 236 pages, x, 21 cm, Aryan miscellany. First-party catalog verified. p6 regional fixed-sign diagram translator note only extracted text; no actual p6 image or proof of ancient diagram or same physical copy as other scans.

sources.title: Square Horoscope Diagrams in Middle Eastern Astrology and Chinese Cosmological Diagrams: Were These Designs Transmitted through the Silk Road?
sources.provider: Johannes Thomann; Brill chapter; University of Zurich author publication list
sources.quality_notes: UZH author bibliography confirms DOI; indexed p97 and Jones 2026 p36 corroborate identity and hypothesis attribution. Publisher full text not fetched; no direct verification of cited originals or transmission.

sources.title: P.Berl. 9825: An elaborate horoscope for 319 CE and its significance for Greek astronomical and astrological practice
sources.quality_notes: Prior Fig2/4/5 screenshots and current PDF index5 Fig3 frame B screenshot actual; four published photographs of one artifact, layout-level reading only. Preserved tabular parts, missing beginning, Syene birth latitude not provenance. No glyph collation or ancient square chart verdict.

sources.title: The Horoscope of AD 497 Attributed to Eutocius: Text, Translation, and Commentary
sources.provider: Alexander Jones; Occasional Notes on the Ancient Astral Sciences 1; NYU archive 2451/75616
sources.quality_notes: PDF indices34–35 actual screenshots pp35–36: unequal quadrant arcs trisected, diagram may postdate text, Thomann hypothesis not proven. Modern redrawing not original manuscript image; AD497 event not folio date; no lineage determination.

sources.title: The Date and Nature of Sphujidhvaja’s Yavanajātaka Reconsidered in the Light of Some Newly Discovered Materials
sources.provider: Bill M. Mak; History of Science in South Asia 1 (2013), 1–20; University of Alberta / Érudit
sources.quality_notes: DOI 10.18732/H2RP4T; extracted pp13–18 rechecked; screenshot index15 blocked. Challenges Pingree reconstructed dates and proposes mixed Greek/Indian work after 22 CE possibly early seventh century; author's argument, not independent Sanskrit original-folio collation or fixed date. No direct Ziwei lineage.
